notes.block: Devanagari, U+0900-U+097F. Words are runs of these letters and signs. The avagraha ऽ (U+093D) is a letter here: Maithili writes it inside and at the end of words (कऽ, भऽ).
notes.notWord: Danda, double danda, digits ०-९ and the abbreviation sign are not word letters.
notes.replace: The normal form is NFC with every ZWJ and ZWNJ dropped (no "joiners" field), and the first two entries drop them before NFC as well. Mis-encoded independent vowels (अ + sign) are mended. The avagraha is often typed as a Latin s (कs for कऽ, 368 times in the Wikipedia text); the five commonest such words are mended.
notes.phraseBreaks: The danda । and double danda ॥ end a sentence.
notes.signs: A vowel sign or virama must follow a consonant or nukta. Anusvara, candrabindu and visarga may follow a vowel (Maithili सँ, केँ) and are not in this list.
notes.translit: Maithili's own transliterator, trained by `make pack-models PACK_LANG=mai` from this folder's tables and Aksharantar mai. On 5,449 held-out Aksharantar mai pairs it puts the right word first 47.8% of the time and in the bar 51.8% (the Hindi pack's, used before 2026.11.13: 46.4% and 50.1%).
notes.minCount: 2, not the usual 3: the only openly licensed Maithili text is its Wikipedia, far smaller than the other packs' text, and at 3 too many real words are lost.
